gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-paquito: Bold letters from Pixelify Sans set the tone, every stroke held to an unvarying weight. But Paquito, a confident serif with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, keeps paragraphs approachable as they pile up.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-aleo: Rod-stock stiff and loud: Pixelify Sans draws horizontals and verticals at identical thickness, a bold, expressive heading. Aleo, a dignified serif with counters the eye slips through, adds classic footing.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-almendra-sc: Unvarying line weight defines Pixelify Sans, so no word ever mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes. And Almendra SC, a classic serif with mouths left open, brings dignified authority underneath.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-antic-slab: Every stroke of Pixelify Sans holds to an unvarying weight, loud and expressive. And Antic Slab, a classic serif with round bowls and wide, barely curled s, gives it dignified editorial company.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-arvo: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with no hairlines and no swells anywhere in its letters. Arvo, a traditional text serif, adds the pair's defining trait: curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-belgrano: A rope-like consistency runs through every stem, bowl and tail of Pixelify Sans. Belgrano, a traditional text serif, is at its finest in open-mouthed curves that stay clear, far from the heading's bold swagger.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-biorhyme: Loud, bold and unvarying: that's Pixelify Sans. BioRhyme, a bookish classic serif, ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, so a touch more size lets those ends show.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-biorhyme-expande: BioRhyme Expanded reads refined and bookish, each word breaking into single letters. Pixelify Sans, bold and expressive at an unvarying line weight, handles the heading while this serif's open e gives the text room.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-cutive: Pixelify Sans is bold, expressive, and stout as a drawn pipe cleaner. It grabs attention in a heading, while Cutive, a refined, literary serif with wide tracking, is better at running text.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-david-libre: Pixelify Sans hums with a flat gray constancy of line weight, made for bold, expressive headings. But David Libre, a dignified text serif whose terminals hang open, does the refined reading work.
